text:
cleo: CSM flagged PulseCare dispute on INV-2026-33421. They say platform fee wasn't adjusted after a staged decomm of 30% to Dedicated and want a retro credit + revised renewal quote.
anika: paste invoice lines? I'll check SFDC.
cleo: invoice extract:
```
INV-2026-33421
Period: 2026-08-01 to 2027-07-31
Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $66,000
Support: Premium (annual) - $15,000
Staged decomm: 30% capacity moved 2026-10-10 to 2026-12-09 (OPS-3010)
Committed GPU overage - 220 hrs @ $13.50/hr = $2,970
```
cleo: PulseCare says AE verbally approved a pro-rata platform reduction for the 60-day decomm and they attached the AE slack thread (no signed amendment).
owen: ops confirms OPS-3010 shows the 30% shift for 60 days. ops did not request billing change.
anika: contract check: platform fee annual non-proratable unless amendment. support proration allowed per clause 5.1. need written sales authorization for platform credit or exec waiver.
cleo: customer requests: 1) support proration for period before Premium started (they say Premium started 2026-09-20), 2) platform pilot credit for 30% * 60/365, 3) exclude 48 hrs test runs from GPU overage.
ownen: ops validated 48 test hrs and flagged them in OPS-3010 comments. attaching logs to the billing record.
anika: quick math: support proration: Premium - Standard = 15,000 - 6,000 = 9,000 annual diff. Standard period 8/1-9/19 = 50 days -> credit = 9,000 * 50/365 = $1,232.88
anika: platform decomm credit (if approved): 66,000 * 0.3 * 60/365 = $3,260.55 approx. GPU test-hour credit = 48 * 13.50 = $648.
finance-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-1500 created for support proration $1,232.88. Reference: INV-2026-33421. Status: pending revenue-ops approval.
cleo: customer pressed for immediate credits to avoid stopping payment on renewal. can we post support proration now?
anika: yes we can post support proration per contract. I'll route CM-2026-1500 for approval.
ownen: ops attached OPS-3010 and logs to invoice record. billing note added: "48 hrs flagged as test; pending CM."
finance-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-1501 created for GPU hour adjustment $648. Reference: INV-2026-33421. Status: pending ops verification.
anika: platform credit > $3k so needs legal + Head of Revenue approval (policy: > $3k escalate). tagging @legal and @sales-ops.
legal: need AE written confirmation or Head of Revenue waiver. if AE slack screenshot contains clear authorization we can consider one-time concession with SAR.
cleo: I have the AE slack screenshot, it's informal: "let's be reasonable, credit for pilot ok." Not solid legal sign-off.
sales-ops: I'll pull the AE's email thread and push for a signed amendment or Exec approval. can we offer a provisional billing memo (non-posted) while legal reviews?
anika: propose: 1) post support proration CM-2026-1500 now, 2) post GPU adjustment CM-2026-1501 after ops verification, 3) create a provisional (non-posting) credit note for platform decomm $3,260.55 labeled "pending legal/sales approval" and include on the renewal quote, 4) place invoice on a 21-day hold to avoid collections action.
leo: collections (via sales-ops): PulseCare requested hold until 2026-12-05. can collections allow 21 days?
sales-ops: yes mark as 21-day strategic hold. I'll notify AR.
legal: if sales can produce an email confirmation or the AE is willing to sign a short amendment, we can approve the $3,260.55 as a one-time commercial concession. require SAR entry.
cleo: customer asked for written confirmation by EOD 2026-11-28. can we meet that?
anika: I'll get CM-2026-1500 queued and notify customer. sales-ops, please push for AE email or Head of Rev sign-off.
ownen: done - OPS-3010 attached, test hrs flagged.
finance-bot: automated: Invoice INV-2026-33421 placed on hold until 2026-12-05. Collections notified.
cleo: thanks all. action items: (1) revenue-ops approve CM-2026-1500 (@anika), (2) ops finalize verification for CM-2026-1501 (@owen), (3) legal+sales confirm AE authorization or escalate (@legal + @sales-ops), (4) collections hold until 2026-12-05 (@sales-ops). I'll update PulseCare once support credit posts and we have timeline for platform decision. :white_check_mark:
